text.p: Italian Btp bond futures ended down but off session lows, pulled down by Spanish Bonos, on Friday position-squaring and EMU uncertainty ahead of an Ecofin meeting starting Sunday night in Luxembourg.

Traders said volumes were not high but the Friday market was reverberating with the usual rumours of a delay to the single European currency. The lira was weaker against the mark as the more fringe European currencies were most penalised.
"Trading on the spreads was again evident and the Italy-Germany gap widened in late business in favour of the Bund," one said. The spread was 144 bps against 137 early on.
